narrative_vs_numbers.summary: Infosys management demonstrated strong execution across FY26, progressively raising FY26 CC revenue growth guidance from 1.0%-3.0% to 2.0%-3.0% in Q2 and eventually to 3.0%-3.5% in Q3, while delivering 3.1% full-year growth. Operating margins remained remarkably stable, comfortably achieving the guided 20.0%-22.0% band across all quarters (21.0% full-year FY26 and 21.1% in Q1 FY27). However, macro headwinds and client-specific decisions forced an early trim to FY27 revenue guidance from 1.5%-3.5% down to 1.5%-3.0% in Q1 FY27.

narrative_vs_numbers.pattern: Management consistently maintains strict operating margin discipline within the 20.0%-22.0% corridor through cost optimization programs like Project Maximus. Revenue guidance is typically adjusted pragmatically as quarter-by-quarter visibility evolves, narrowing or trimming upper bands when macro conditions or volume conversions soften.
